A '''crewman''' aboard the [[Haj Shipping Lines]] [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Star of Empire]]'' was among a group of survivors led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hajj]] after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] known as [[Systems Infiltration Manager]] took control of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[0 ABY/Legends|eleven months after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. While attempting to reach the ship's communications room, the crewman was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[M-4D0]], acting under SIM's control, blasted a hole in the hull, causing the crewman to be blown into [[Realspace/Legends|space]].
